related.label: Valori
related.summary: replaces floating point with Q16.16 fixed-point arithmetic in the memory layer, so that stored states, snapshots and search results are bit-identical across platforms. It shares the goal of platform-independent state; SEMQ keeps the float32 inputs, makes their encoding and its identity deterministic instead, and adds diff and a rebuild gate.
